Privacy Policy

Last Updated: June 10, 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how khgtech collects, uses, and protects information when you use our platform at https://khgtech.vip. khgtech is a software system designed to help users streamline their workflows and perform their work more effectively.

1. Information We Collect

When you use khgtech, we may collect:

  • Account and contact details you provide when registering or contacting us
  • Usage data such as pages visited, features used, and session duration
  • Device and browser information including IP address and browser type
  • Basic TikTok profile information (open ID, display name, avatar) when you sign in using TikTok Login Kit

2. How We Use Your Information

khgtech uses collected information to provide and improve the platform, authenticate users, respond to support requests, and ensure platform security.

3. TikTok Integration

If you connect your TikTok account, khgtech uses the user.info.basic, video.upload, and video.publish scopes to enable sign-in and content posting features. We do not store your TikTok credentials.

4. Information Sharing

We do not sell or rent your personal information. We share data only with trusted service providers under confidentiality agreements, when required by law, or with your explicit consent.

5. Data Security

We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information. Data is encrypted in transit and access is strictly controlled.

6. Data Retention

We retain your data only as long as necessary to provide the service or as required by law. You may request deletion at any time.

7. Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. Contact us to exercise these rights.

8. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. Changes will be posted at https://khgtech.vip/privacy.

9. Contact Us

Questions? Reach us at https://khgtech.vip/contact.
